MSIX packaging for .NET desktop apps: create from csproj (`WindowsPackageType`) or WAP; sign; distribute via Store, App Installer, SCCM/Intune; configure auto-updates and multi-architecture `.msixbundle`; build in CI/CD. Assumptions: Windows App SDK 1.6+, .NET 8.0+, Windows 10 build 19041+ (1709+ for App Installer auto-update). WinUI/AOT: [skill:dotnet-winui], [skill:dotnet-native-aot]; CI: [skill:dotnet-gha-patterns], [skill:dotnet-ado-patterns]; NuGet: [skill:dotnet-nuget-authoring]; containers: [skill:dotnet-containers]. Examples: [references/detailed-examples.md](references/detailed-examples.md).

Modern WinUI 3 can package directly from `.csproj`; WPF/WinForms use a Visual Studio “Windows Application Packaging Project” (`.wapproj`) referencing `..\MyWpfApp\MyWpfApp.csproj`. Set `WindowsPackageType` to `MSIX`; output packages to `$(SolutionDir)AppPackages\`.

All MSIX packages must be signed to install on Windows. The signing certificate's Subject must match the `Publisher` attribute in the package manifest.

```powershell
$cert = New-Self-SignedCertificate `
-Subject "CN=My Company, O=My Company, L=Seattle, S=WA, C=US" `
-FriendlyName "MyApp Dev Signing" `
-CertStoreLocation "Cert:\CurrentUser\My" `
-TextExtension @("<REDACTED_IP>={text}<REDACTED_IP>.<REDACTED_IP>.3", `
"<REDACTED_IP>={text}")
$password = ConvertTo-SecureString -String "$env:CERT_PASSWORD" -Force -AsPlainText
Export-PfxCertificate -Cert $cert `
-FilePath "MyApp_DevSigning.pfx" `
$signtool = Get-ChildItem "C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Kits\10\bin\*\x64\signtool.exe" |
Sort-Object { [version]($_.Directory.Parent.Name) } -Descending |
Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
& $signtool sign /fd SHA256 /a /f "MyApp_DevSigning.pfx" `
/p "$env:CERT_PASSWORD" `
"AppPackages\MyApp_1.0.0.0_x64.msix"
& signtool.exe sign /fd SHA256 /sha1 "THUMBPRINT_HERE" `
/tr http://timestamp.digicert.com /td SHA256 `
"AppPackages\MyApp_1.0.0.0_x64.msix"
& signtool.exe sign /fd SHA256 /f "production-cert.pfx" `
/p "$env:CERT_PASSWORD" `
/tr http://timestamp.digicert.com /td SHA256 `
"AppPackages\MyApp_1.0.0.0_x64.msix"
```

Store apps are re-signed by Microsoft; no production signing certificate is needed for Store-only distribution. Direct down
